tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the Chinese cities/regions covered by simplechinatrip.com with attraction counts and guide page URLs.

tools.name: search_attractions
tools.description: Search China attractions by city slug and/or keyword (English or Chinese name). Returns slug, name, whether reservation is required, release rule, and page URL. Use get_booking_guide for full booking steps.

tools.name: get_booking_guide
tools.description: How a foreign visitor books a specific China attraction: official channel, passport acceptance, ticket release time, prices, hours, closures, pitfalls, step-by-step instructions, Trip.com link (if available), page URL and last-verified date.
